# Inventory API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A place where the lab keeps track of its consumable stock.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/inventory/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/personal_attributes/inventory/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `inventory` (detail, create, update), `inventories` (list)
- **Permissions:** object permissions on the record itself (member / manager / owner roles)
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`inventorygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/inventorygroupmembershipinvitation/), [`inventorymembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/inventorymembershipinvitation/) records; refused (400) while [`consumablestock`](/api/modules/consumablestock/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 50 characters |
| `location` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Location of the inventory, e.g., "Room 302, Cabinet B, ESD-safe storage" or "-80°C Freezer, Bay 3, Boxes V1-V10". |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `is_public` | boolean. Designates if the inventory is publicly available |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `groups` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/inventory/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('inventory', load_all=True)
records = resp['inventories']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('inventory', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.inventories;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "inventories": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Inventory 1",
            "location": "",
            "description": "",
            "is_public": true,
            "users": null,
            "groups": null,
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/inventory/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('inventory', data={"name": "Inventory 1"})
record = resp.json()['inventory']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Inventory 1'), 'inventory');
record = created.inventory;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/inventory/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('inventory', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['inventory']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('inventory', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.inventory;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "inventory": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Inventory 1",
        "location": "",
        "description": "",
        "is_public": true,
        "users": null,
        "groups": null,
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/inventory/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('inventory', id='<id>', data={"name": "Inventory 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Inventory 1 (renamed)'), 'inventory', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/inventory/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('inventory', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'inventory');
```
